national_news.title: CCEA Approves Rs 14,105 Crore Kalai-II Hydroelectric Project on Lohit River
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved a Rs 14,105.83 crore investment for the 1,200 MW Kalai-II Hydroelectric Project on the Lohit River in Anjaw district, Arunachal Pradesh.

Developed as a joint venture between THDC India Limited (NTPC subsidiary) and the Arunachal Pradesh Government, the 78-month run-of-the-river project is planned to generate 4,852.95 MU of power annually.

Environmental evaluations highlight risks to the Eastern Himalaya biodiversity hotspot, specifically impacting the critically endangered White-bellied Heron (Schedule I of Wildlife Protection Act) and proximity to Namdapha Tiger Reserve and Kamlang Wildlife Sanctuary.

national_news.title: HM Amit Shah inaugurates 12th NDRF Battalion campus in Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 12th Battalion campus of the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) at Hollongi near Itanagar to boost Northeast disaster management infrastructure.
Launched development projects worth over ₹5,600 crore spanning education, power, rural roads, and border areas, alongside the Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Vision Document 2027.
Advised the Indian Army and ITBP to procure agricultural produce directly from local farmers to boost self-reliance and local rural economy under the Swavalamban Yojana.

national_news.title: IFFI screens 'Naqsh-e-Daur' showcasing Kashmir's woodcarving art
bullets: The film 'Naqsh-e-Daur', directed by Baba Tasadduq Hussain and produced by Bharat Bala, was screened at the 57th edition of the International Film Festival of India (IFFI).
The documentary highlights Kashmir's rich artistic heritage through the life and craftsmanship of Padma Shri awardee Ghulam Nabi Dar.
The film forms part of Virtual Bharat's initiative to present authentic Indian cultural stories and traditional art forms on national platforms.

national_news.title: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah undertakes two-day visit to India
bullets: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah arrived in New Delhi on a two-day official visit, his first visit to India since taking office in March.
The bilateral talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar reinforce India's 'Neighbourhood First' policy.
Discussions and MoUs focus on key bilateral sectors including trade, water resources, digital connectivity, start-ups, and technology.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Skill Development and Announces WorldSkills Asia 2027 at Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow, emphasizing skill development guided by the principle of 'Shrameva Jayate'.
An investment of Rs 60,000 crore has been allocated under the PM-SETU scheme to modernise ITI infrastructure, upgrade machinery, and strengthen industry linkages.
PM Modi announced that India will host the WorldSkills Asia competition in Greater Noida in 2027, showcasing India's progression towards becoming the global skill capital.

national_news.title: BHASHINI's AI Voice Prescription Tool Expands Across Public Healthcare Institutions
bullets: BHASHINI, the government-backed language AI platform under MeitY, is expanding its speech-to-text voice prescription tool across AIIMS New Delhi following successful pilots.
The tool integrates into NIC's eHospital module, enabling doctors to dictate outpatient prescriptions directly into electronic medical records in English and Indian languages.
The voice AI technology has also been integrated into JIPMER's e-Sushrut system and the Indian Army's Dhanwantri system to streamline clinical workflows.

national_news.title: NHAI Expands Multi-Lane Free Flow Tolling System Across National Highway Network
bullets: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) activated its Multi-Lane Free Flow (MLFF) barrier-free tolling system at Chennasamudram Plaza on NH-48 in Tamil Nadu.
The MLFF system utilizes FASTag RFID readers and Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras, allowing vehicles to pass seamlessly at speeds up to 150 km/h.
This initiative is part of NHAI's phased nationwide rollout targeting 16 toll plazas to eliminate congestion, reduce fuel consumption, and lower emissions.

national_news.title: Union Home Minister Reviews Border Security and Infrastructure in Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired a high-level security and border management review meeting in Itanagar to evaluate security along Arunachal Pradesh’s 1,126-km border with China.
Stressed the execution of the Vibrant Villages Programme alongside expanding road connectivity, border outposts, helipads, and telecommunication infrastructure.
Highlighted a targeted approach under Mission Krishi Veer and Mission Arun Himveer to equip local border villages to meet the operational needs of security forces.

bihar_news.title: PM Inaugurates 'Nitish Setu' Cable Bridge in Vaishali, Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the six-lane extradosed cable bridge named 'Nitish Setu' during his visit to Vaishali, Bihar.
The cable bridge spans across the Ganga River, connecting Kacchi Dargah in Patna with Bidupur in Vaishali to alleviate traffic on existing bridges.
The bridge aims to facilitate smoother movement of agricultural produce, dairy products, and facilitate better healthcare and educational connectivity.

bihar_news.title: PM Unveils Infrastructure Projects Worth Rs 34,000 Crore in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated and laid the foundation stones for development projects worth around Rs 34,000 crore in Vaishali, Bihar.
Key completed projects include the 19.36 km 'Nitish Setu' (Rs 5,571.69 crore), Unit-2 of the 660 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, a floating solar project at Phulwaria Dam, and 100 PM-e-buses.
Foundation stones were laid for the four-laning of NH-139W (Sahebganj-Areraj-Bettiah), power evacuation for Pirpainti Super Thermal Power Project, and a research park at IIT Patna.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's First IT Park to be Developed in Gardanibagh, Patna
bullets: Bihar's first state-of-the-art IT Park is being established at Gardanibagh in Patna at an estimated cost of Rs 413 crore.
National Buildings Construction Corporation (NBCC) has been appointed as the implementing agency, with a gross monetisation value estimated at Rs 1,071 crore over a 90-year lease.
The facility will include a seven-storey five-star hotel, and project implementation will be monitored by a committee headed by the IT Department Secretary/ACS.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Setup Digital Planetariums; SVANidhi Samman Awards 2026 Presented
bullets: Bihar Science and Technology Department announced plans for new digital planetariums in East Champaran, Jamui, and Purnia costing Rs 39 crore under the Union Ministry of Culture's SPOCS scheme.
The new additions will join existing planetariums in Patna and Darbhanga to ensure science education centers across all administrative divisions of Bihar.
Separately, Union MoHUA Minister Manohar Lal presented the SVANidhi Samman Awards 2026, recognizing Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh for leading overall performance.
